no-restricted-globals.name: Proxy
no-restricted-globals.message: Write the behaviour out as plain functions: a Proxy hides what a property access does (least power, docs/engineering/code-design-principles.md).

patterns.message: src/domain/ imports only src/domain/, src/utils/ and plain libraries such as zod: no UI, sync, browser storage or server packages (docs/engineering/code-layout.md).
